description: In the Dark of Monday Morning: Waves Inundate a Pacific Island Community is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies; University of Hawai'i Sea Grant College Program; Secretariat of the Pacific Regional Environment Programme. People who live on low-lying islands are reminded daily of the threat they face from coastal flooding. An unexpected disaster prompted a community in the Republic of the Marshall Islands to consider how to notify people of potential events and help them know how to respond. Coverage: the United States (2016). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
